hooks.command: afplay /System/Library/Sounds/Glass.aiff 2>/dev/null & PROJ=$(echo "$PWD" | tr '/' '-'); LATEST=$(ls -t ~/.claude/projects/"$PROJ"/*.jsonl 2>/dev/null | head -1); [ -n "$LATEST" ] && MSG=$(grep '"role":"assistant"' "$LATEST" 2>/dev/null | jq -rs 'map(select(any(.message.content[]?; .type == "text"))) | last | [.message.content[] | select(.type=="text") | .text] | join(" ")' 2>/dev/null | cut -c1-500) && [ -n "$MSG" ] && say -v Samantha -r 180 "$MSG"
